nodes.recap: chapter header and morning in rebel base
nodes.text:
-------------------------------
|          CHAPTER 13          |
-------------------------------


$CYou did not sleep long.##

The oil lanterns had burned low by the time your eyes finally closed,#
and they are low still, orange and guttering.# But the rebel base
is already alive with quiet, deliberate movement, people checking straps,#
passing weapons, looking at maps.##

Riff is at the table. He has not slept, and his eyes are iron.

nodes.recap: Riff briefs the group on the plan

dialogues.precomment:
He has laid out a hand-drawn map of the Municipal building on the table,#
weighted at the corners by spent lanterns.# It is detailed,
the work of months spent watching, probing, losing people, learning.
dialogues.line:
Seven floors. The Projector is on the top.# Every floor has a guard rotation:
two on the landings, two in the corridors, all controlled, all armed.
dialogues.comment: He traces the route with a finger.

dialogues.line:
Our fighters take the front entrance.# Loud, direct, as much noise as we can make.#
The guards will respond.# They have to, Joe's programming does not allow
for ignoring a frontal assault.# That draws them down and toward the main doors.#
While they are focused there, you go in the side.
dialogues.comment: He taps a point on the east wall of the building.

replies.line: "And once we are inside? Give me the route."
"Where do we go, exactly, once we are through that door?"

dialogues.line:
Service entrance, maintenance corridor, stairwell to your left.# Go straight up,#
and do not stop to fight unless you have to.# Every second you spend on the lower floors
is a second a free person is dying out front to buy you time.
dialogues.comment: His voice does not waver, but his jaw tightens.

dialogues.precomment:
Corolla's hand settles at her hip, where a blade should hang.#
It closes on empty air, and her mouth thins.
dialogues.line:
Don't stop to fight.# With what, exactly?##
They stripped us in the cells. I have not held my knife since they took us,
and I would rather not go chest to chest with an armored guard
wearing nothing but good intentions.
I would.

dialogues.precomment: Riff nods, like a man who has been waiting for the question.
dialogues.line:
Everything Joe's people confiscate, they log and lock away.#
Second floor, an administrative level, a storage locker among the offices.#
If your weapons are still in that building, that is where they will be.##
It is on your way up. Take back what is yours, but be quick about it.
dialogues.comment: He taps the second floor on the map, twice.

dialogues.precomment: Corolla is studying the map, her eyes moving with quick precision.
dialogues.line: The psychic door. You mentioned it last night.

Top floor, one room before the Projector chamber.#
Flat gray wall, no handle, no lock, no visible mechanism.#
We hit it with a battering ram for two hours once, left not so much as a scratch.
dialogues.comment: He looks at Math and Efeliah.

dialogues.precomment:
Math nods slowly.# He looks steadier than last night; the rest has helped.#
His eyes are still bloodshot, but the dullness is gone.
dialogues.line:
A psi-lock.# It responds to mental resonance, not physical force.#
Efeliah and I can open it, if we conserve what we have until we reach it.#
We must not expend our strength in the lower floors.
I am ready.
dialogues.comment: She says it simply.# And she means it.

dialogues.precomment:
Everyone looks at Theo. He is standing with his arms folded,
his burned forearm wrapped in clean cloth from last night,#
and he looks like a man who has had a full night's sleep.#

He looks, in other words, like a force of nature.
dialogues.line: We go.

dialogues.precomment:
Everyone turns to Smiurl. He has both hands pressed against his face,#
his skin cycling through a rapid sequence of colors: orange, purple, an anxious green.
dialogues.line:
I hate this plan.# I hate it completely.# But I am also here and not hiding,#
and that means I am going with you, even though the plan is terrible.
Just so we are clear that I think it is terrible.
dialogues.comment:
He lowers his hands, his chin set, his eyes bright.##

Corolla puts a hand briefly on his shoulder, says nothing.

nodes.recap: moving out through rebel tunnels toward the building
nodes.text:
The rebels arm themselves in silence.# Riff distributes what weapons they have,#
knives mostly, a few short clubs, two bows, simple tools for a desperate job.##

You move out in single file, back into the maintenance passages.#
Riff leads, you follow, and Corolla takes the rear.##

The city above bleeds through the grates in the ceiling, and you catch glimpses
as you pass beneath them: blue-white light and shadow, the undersides of boots,#
the mechanical even cadence of guards on patrol, the golden shimmer that passes
for sky on the streets above, beautiful and false.##

$c<<All of this.# All of this just to keep one man's hands around everyone's throat.>>#

$CThe thought makes something cold and sharp settle in your chest. You keep walking.##

nodes.recap: parting from Riff, and what the diversion is going to cost them [DECISION: replies]
nodes.text:
The passage ends at a stairwell that smells of the street above, and the rebels
come up out of the dark in twos and threes and gather at its mouth,#
without a word being given.##

Riff stops on the top step.##

dialogues.line:
This is where we separate.# Take that road,# then the first turning left,#
and you will be standing at the side of the Municipal building.##
When you hear our signal, move.# We will not be able to hold for long.
dialogues.comment: He puts out a hand, grips Theo's forearm once, and lets it go.

dialogues.line: Good luck.
dialogues.comment: Then he turns, and he is gone among his own people.

dialogues.precomment: You stay where you are, watching them go.
dialogues.line: Come on.

replies.line: "Wait. What does 'we cannot hold for long' mean?"
"Not yet. How much risk are they taking out there?"

dialogues.precomment:
She looks at you for a moment.# Then she turns and looks at the rebels
as they thin out into the side streets, and at the little three-wheeled
carts they have pulled up behind them, ready to run.
dialogues.line:
Maximum.##

Maximum risk.
dialogues.comment: She says it twice, and the second time is much worse than the first.

dialogues.line: Then perhaps we really should not have come.
dialogues.comment: You say it to the ground between your boots.

dialogues.line:
Don't.# They said it themselves, remember?# They have no other choice.##
This was going to be their ending either way.

dialogues.precomment: Efeliah steps up beside you, and her voice is not gentle at all.
dialogues.line:
Which is exactly why we have to be quick.# Shut the Projector down in time
and the troops sent after them will lose their orders in the middle of the chase.##
Riff's people will reach the Mazerock alive.

dialogues.precomment:
You look at her for a few seconds. Then you sigh, and you go.##

You are almost at the end of the street before the question occurs to you.
dialogues.line: What exactly is their signal?

nodes.text:
You emerge into an alley.##

The Municipal building looms above you, close enough to touch.#
Up close it is uglier than it looked from the approach: gray concrete poured
without care, functional and brutal, the architecture of cheap and pragmatic control.#
No decoration, no windows on the lower floors, just seven floors of solid, humming menace.##

Then, from the far side of the building:##

Shouting.##

A crash, the sound of boots at a dead run.# Somewhere around the corner,#
Riff's fighters have met the front doors.##

Corolla looks at you, her hand already on her blade.##

$R"Now."$C##

The service door is a heavy metal slab in the east wall, its lock industrial,#
built for durability rather than resistance.##

Theo examines it for approximately one second, then puts his weight against it.#
The mechanism does not break so much as $Wgive up$C, the bolt shearing from its housing
with a sound like a gunshot, and the door swings open.##

Inside, a corridor of bare concrete, lit by sickly emergency strips,#
the smell of machine oil and recycled air, and to the left, immediately, a stairwell.##

You go in, and the door closes behind you, the sounds of battle fading
to a muffled, distant drumbeat.##

$c<<One floor at a time. Don't think about the top. Just the next step.>>$C##

You reach the second-floor landing and stop.##

Two guards block the corridor ahead, and they turn immediately, mechanically,#
raising their batons.# No hesitation, no communication, Joe's signal handles the tactics.##

Corolla is already moving.# You'll have to go bare-knuckles for this one.##

encounter.victoryMessage:
They fall, not like warriors but like machines unplugged,
crumpling to the floor with blank faces and open eyes.#
Somewhere beneath those headbands, people are still in there,#
and you do not let yourself think about that.
encounter.defeatMessage:
The guards press forward, baton strikes driving you back against the stairwell wall,#
blankness where there should be a face, the headband pulsing.##

$Y[You have been captured. I hope you like your new headband... not that it matters.]$C

nodes.text:
The guards are down, the corridor empty.# To the right, the floor opens
into a gray administrative space of desks, cabinets, filing systems,#
and to the left, the stairwell continues upward.##

The second floor.# This is the level Riff marked on the map,#
the one where Joe's people log and lock away what they take.#
Your weapons are here, somewhere.##

You have perhaps two minutes before the diversion loses momentum.##

$D[Type an action at the prompt. Press TAB for help.]$C

actions.answer:
The floor is an administrative level of desks, cabinets, and filing systems.
A weapon storage locker is mounted on the far wall,
and the downed guards carry basic equipment.

objects.answer: A weapons locker, locked with a standard key mechanism. The guard must carry the key.
You check the guards. Both carry heavy batons and one has a small ring of keys on his belt.

Administrative records. Lists of names, schedules,
columns of numbers in a corrupted script you cannot read.
The neatness of it turns your stomach: the bureaucracy of control.
You take a guard's baton. Better than bare hands.
You take the key ring from the guard's belt. One of these should fit the locker.

actions.answer: What do you want to open?

condition.refusal: The locker is locked. I need a key.

objects.answer:
The key fits, and the locker swings open on your confiscated gear,
tossed in a heap where Joe's people left it: your own sword,
Corolla's knife and bolas coiled tight, and Theo's heavy hammer.

Armed again. Now you can climb.

actions.answer: The stairwell is to your left.

condition.refusal:
Not without our weapons.# Riff said the gear Joe took is locked up
on this floor, and I am not climbing to the Projector bare-handed.

actions.answer: There is no time to rest. The diversion will not last forever.

nodes.text:
You climb.##

Floors three and four are clear, the diversion having pulled the guards down,#
and you pass empty offices, empty corridors, the hum of the building's machinery
growing louder as you ascend.# Somewhere below, the sounds of fighting have grown
more intense: shouts, crashes, the sharp crack of something improvised and desperate.##

Corolla sets the pace, moving with a hunter's economy of motion.#
Theo keeps the rear, and Smiurl stays in the middle, his skin dimmed
to what he seems to feel to be camouflage.##

Floor five.##

The stairwell door opens onto a corridor that is different from the ones below.#
The lighting is brighter, the walls are cleaner, and from somewhere above,#
pressing down like a physical weight, you can feel something.##

Like standing under a thunderstorm.# Again.##
The air is heavy.# Wrong.#

Efeliah stops and presses one hand to the wall, her breathing changing.##

dialogues.precomment: She does not open her eyes.
dialogues.line:
It is above us, two floors.# I can feel the signal from here, and it is enormous,#
like standing next to a waterfall and trying to think.#
Every mind in this building, in this city, is being pressed through it,
squeezed, shaped, redirected.

dialogues.precomment: Math's face is strained. He is feeling it too.
dialogues.line:
The psi-lock will be on floor six, one floor up.#
We need to reach it with enough strength to open it.# Ef...
I am fine.
dialogues.comment: She opens her eyes. They are clear, steady, determined.

dialogues.precomment: Corolla is already at the stairwell door, peering through its narrow window.
dialogues.line:
Three guards on the next landing, and one who looks like an officer.#
Heavier armor, the same dead eyes, unfortunately.

nodes.recap: guards and armored officer on floor 6 landing
nodes.text:
You hit them fast, before they can set a formation.##

Three guards in standard gray, and behind them an officer in heavier armor,#
a segmented plate over the chest that makes Theo's eyes narrow with something
approaching professional interest.# All four have the same blank faces,#
and all four attack the moment you appear.##

It is not a heroic charge but a brawl on a landing, limited by the stairwell's
geometry, with the sounds of combat from below driving up through the walls
like a drumbeat.##

encounter.victoryMessage:
The officer is the last to fall.# Theo does it, a single blow that folds
the armored chest like foil, and the headband keeps pulsing for a moment
after the man hits the floor.# Then it goes dark.##
encounter.defeatMessage:
The officer's armored shoulder drives you back, the guards swarm,#
and you lose ground, step by step, until the stairwell wall is at your back.##

$WIt seems your little insurrection has come to an abrupt end.## Such a shame.$C

nodes.recap: Corolla struck by a ray from the gallery
nodes.text:
You are all still standing, but only just, and you have barely taken stock of that
when a ray fired from the far end of the gallery catches Corolla across the back.##

The flash of it is brief, almost incidental, but the sound she makes is not.#
You see her clothes blacken along the shoulder and spine,
see her lurch forward and start to crumple, and you catch her before she can fall.##

She is a dead weight in your arms, unconscious, her skin hot where the beam
has burned through fabric and into flesh.##

$c"Corolla!# Corolla, no..."$C

Smiurl is at your side in an instant, his hands under her other arm,
his skin flashing alarm-orange.# Her breathing is steady, but she does not stir.##

nodes.recap: floor 6 corridor - the psychic door in sight
nodes.text:
The sixth-floor corridor stretches before you, and at the far end,#
perhaps twenty meters, is the door.##

You recognize it immediately, even though you have never seen it,#
because it is $Wnot$C there.# Or rather, it is: a section of wall, perfectly flush,#
without seam or frame or handle, an absence shaped like a door, smooth as a mirror
and as dead as a stone.##

You carry Corolla between you and Smiurl, her weight distributed across both your shoulders.#
She has not woken.# Theo keeps a hand near her neck as you move,
checking the pulse there with a practiced calm he does not bother to explain.##

The air around the door presses against the inside of your skull, a sensation
like pressure, like standing at altitude, warm and slightly wrong.##

Efeliah exhales slowly, Math straightens, and they look at each other.##

nodes.recap: chapter end - Math and Efeliah prepare at the door
nodes.text:
Below, the rebel assault continues, the building shaking, occasionally,#
with the impact of something violent happening many floors down.#
Riff's fighters, still buying time.##

Corolla is propped against the wall between you and Smiurl,
still unconscious, her breathing even.# You cannot do anything for her yet.#
Theo glances at her once, then at the door, and his jaw sets.##

Smiurl's skin has gone a resolute, steady gold, which, for Smiurl,#
is the bravest color there is.##

$c"Last floor. The Projector is right there.#
All we have to do is get through a door that cannot be opened."$C

Math takes a slow breath, and Efeliah reaches out and takes his hand.##
